item.title: Smith Lake resort repeal bill passes House
item.description: MONTGOMERY — After several lengthy rounds of hazing from her Democrat colleagues, State Rep. Cindy Myrex (R-Cullman) ushered Senate Bill 12 (SB12) through the House into passage by a 98-0 margin, with four abstentions.The legislation repeals Senate Bill 322 (SB322), which laid the groundwork for a resort project including golf courses, restaurants, a hotel, and other outdoor activities in an area that would have been annexed into the City of Cullman but was not contiguous to the actual city. item.title: Trump endorses ALGOP chair Wahl as possible candidate for lieutenant governor
item.description: President Donald Trump endorsed Alabama Republican Party chairman John Wahl for lieutenant governor on Thursday.The last day to qualify for the Republican primary is Friday. Wahl has yet to officially enter the lieutenant governor's race, but said last year he was "strongly considering" running.
